text:
incidents-bot: NOTICE: Multiple customers reporting duplicated embedding units on billed usage and occasional duplicate embedding results. Investigating cause and scope. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2063456789-metering-publisher-duplication

sam-sre: We saw a sudden jump in embed-publish retries from the telemetry ingesters; duplicate messages are being committed to the metering topic under high backpressure. Suspect idempotence settings on the new producer release (v2.9.0) didn't enable sequence checks. 5xxs are low, but duplication rate for events ~1.3% in eu-west1.

rick-telemetry: Rolling the telemetry publisher back to v2.8.4 now. Pausing non-critical event producers to stop further duplicates. Backfill dedupe job queued. ETA for rollback + pause propagation across zones ~12m. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/telemetry/pulls/519

lila-finance: Heads up: billing pipeline currently charges per embedding unit on ingestion. If duplicates make it into the metering topic we risk double-charging customers. I've flagged billing to hold immediate invoicing for today and to start a reconcile. @billing-bot can you pause invoice generation for the affected window?

billing-bot: Acknowledged. Pausing invoice generation for metering-window 2063456500-2063457600. Will mark tentative credits for affected customers. Link: https://internal.redwood.ai/tools/billing/pause/2063456789

anya-support: Drafting customer-facing status note. Proposed copy pinned in #support-ops: "We are investigating duplicate embedding events that may show as duplicated usage on some accounts. We have paused billing for the affected ingestion window and will issue credits if duplicates are confirmed. We'll update within 30 minutes." Please review.

sam-sre: Mitigation steps executed so far:
- 2063456810: paused non-critical telemetry producers in eu-west1
- 2063456852: rollback of telemetry-publisher triggered to v2.8.4 (canary starting eu-west1-zone-b)
- 2063456900: queued dedupe backfill job (id: dedupe-2063456789) to run after rollback

rick-telemetry: Canary rollback healthy on zone-b at 2063457024, duplicate event rate dropped ~78% there. Rolling to remaining zones in 2 waves. Backfill will run with strict idempotence checks (producer seq + event-hash dedupe).

lila-finance: From a billing perspective: we'll automatically apply credits for any event-based duplication detected by reconcile. Support team will get a list of affected accounts for outreach. Expect preliminary credit list in ~45m.

anya-support: Support guidance (copy/paste):
"Thanks for flagging this. We detected duplicate embedding events in our metering system and have paused billing for the affected window. We're running an automated reconciliation and will apply credits where duplicates are found. If you see duplicated results in the API response, please share request IDs and sample payloads and we'll prioritize your ticket. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2063456789-metering-publisher-duplication"

sam-sre: Quick check for eng-telemetry to find duplicates in kafka topic:
```
kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --topic metering.events --from-beginning --max-messages 5000 | jq -r '.event_hash' | sort | uniq -c | awk '$1>1'
```
This lists event_hash counts >1. Look for >1 duplicates.

rick-telemetry: Runbook step executed: "pause-publishers-and-backfill" - https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/metering-duplication. Pager rotations are active.

sam-sre: Timeline (so far):
- 2063456500: telemetry-publisher v2.9.0 deployed to eu-west1
- 2063456588: first duplicate alerts from synthetic reconciliation checks
- 2063456810: paused non-critical producers
- 2063456852: rollback started
- 2063457024: canary rollback success in zone-b

lila-finance: Next steps from finance: hold today's invoice run, run a reconcile job that subtracts deduped events, and queue credits. I'll post the reconcile job id when queued.

anya-support: Customer note v1 posted to status page at 2063457100. Support queue may spike; please follow routing doc pinned in #support-ops.

sam-sre: Current status: rollback in progress, dedupe backfill scheduled to start after full rollback completes. Expect most duplication symptoms to be resolved in 30-60m. If you see continued duplicates after 2063457660, escalate to on-call with traces.

incidents-bot: Update posted to status page and incident channel. Next automated reminder in 20 minutes. :loud_sound:
